headline.text: L1 Sollich 1 depositor rod broke at 10:58 — *2 hours down* for repair, still offline at window close.

per_plant_summary.L1: L1 ran three lines. Sollich 1 broke a depositor rod at 10:58 and was down for the rest of the shift. Sollich 3 hit over-pressure alarms at 17:13, cleared after reheat and equipment faults, then shut down after hitting order. Sollich 4 had a 9-minute cook-time overage and dry texture in candy as of 12:21 — both still open at window close. Facilities noted water leaks in IMS area and a broken cable tray on Big Joe #4.
per_plant_summary.L2: L2 ran two lines with no breaks. ML2 completed a changeover to 10-count displays at 03:10 and ran clean through the window. FFS ran pouches all shift with routine quality checks. Upstairs temperature reported cold — facilities to check.
per_plant_summary.L3: L3 ran four lines. Matrix sealing issue at 02:38 is still open; no-combination faults cleared by 05:33 after flap adjustments. Truffle line brought weight and appearance back to spec by 07:49 after operator adjustments. ML1 completed startup and temper checks with no issues. ML4 ran depositors 1 and 4; depositor 1 stopped at 12:50. Roof leak upstairs — facilities aware.

notes.text: Warehouse delivered Sollich 4 flow wrap 20 minutes late; line started cooking at 17:20.
One LPN for item 10175 not entered by previous shift; discovered during inventory at 23:22.
Incorrect centerline sheet used on Matrix for two days; operator corrected at 12:53.
Leon completed Cavanna infeed photo-eye improvement work on ML1.

resolved.title: S3 over-pressure alarms and equipment faults
resolved.summary: Enrober threw over-pressure alarms at 17:13; line stopped. After reheat, screw drive, wire belt, and return pump all faulted at 19:26.
resolved.resolution: Fixed at 19:28 — "It's fixed and running" (Caleb York). Order hit and line shut down for cleaning at 19:37.

resolved.title: Flow wrap materials delay for Sollich 4
resolved.summary: Warehouse did not deliver flow wrap by 17:03; line could not start cooking until materials arrived.
resolved.resolution: Flow wrap arrived at 17:20 and line started cooking (Dakota Adair).

resolved.title: S1 checkweigher issues during Matrix setup
resolved.summary: Checkweigher had issues during setup for Matrix 9 and 10; maintenance troubleshooting at 09:00.
resolved.resolution: Setup completed and line started running at 09:25 (Victor Romero Sr.).

resolved.title: S4 mixing rod sensor not reading
resolved.summary: Mixing rod would not mix at 09:55; maintenance called to troubleshoot sensor failure.
resolved.resolution: Sensor corrected at 10:01 — "The sensor was not reading correctly, we are mixing the ingredients now" (Karla Uribe).

resolved.title: S4 high PSI and temperature stack 1 off
resolved.summary: Pressure spiked above 120 PSI; Marcos flushed pipe and restarted, then found Stack 1 at 120°F instead of 180°F.
resolved.resolution: Pipe flushed and restarted; temperature stack found off and corrected at 11:02 (Chris Jeffs).

resolved.title: Work order 44684 not released in NetSuite
resolved.summary: S4 Kitchen could not find WO #44684 in system to start production.
resolved.resolution: Work order released at 19:59 — "The WO is released" (Nidia Lopez Corea).

resolved.title: S1 floor sanitization after drain water
resolved.summary: Drain water affected floor areas; production was busy and sanitizer not yet applied as of 22:05.

resolved.title: MF Matrix machine auto-stopping on start
resolved.summary: Machine would start then automatically switch to "stop" mode at 07:08, preventing operation.
resolved.resolution: Nathan manually cycled machine at 07:10 — "running again." Root cause found at 12:38: over-discharge setting was off (Nathan Ruiz).

resolved.title: MF Matrix no-combination fault causing line stops
resolved.summary: Line stopped repeatedly with "no combination fault" overnight; machine unable to find acceptable weight buckets to fill pouches.
resolved.resolution: Kavin adjusted orange flaps at 05:33 — pieces per bucket dropped from 3-5 to 1-3, line running. "Nice. That makes sense" (Shawn Jewkes, 05:36).

resolved.title: Truffle line weight and appearance out of spec
resolved.summary: Line handed off at shift change with final weight outside spec and appearance out of spec at 06:53.
resolved.resolution: Operator made adjustments; weight check passed at 07:49 and organoleptic test passed — "appearance looks good" (David Zuniaga).

resolved.title: Truffle flow-wrap hold inspection
resolved.summary: Found two unlabeled bags of flow wrap on same pallet as defective rolls placed on hold; unclear if defective.
resolved.resolution: All six partial rolls used without any issues at 12:08 — "All six rolls ran perfectly" (Grey Boscan).

needs_attention.title: S1 depositor rod broken
needs_attention.summary: Rod that moves the depositor broke at 10:58; Matt and Jakob working repair with 2-hour estimate.
needs_attention.status: Estimated back online at 13:30 per Jorge at 11:24. Still down at window close (12:57).

needs_attention.title: Big Joe #4 cable tray broken, cables exposed
needs_attention.summary: Cable tray broken with exposed cables; unit tagged out of service, key removed to Curt's desk.
needs_attention.status: Unit tagged out at 04:21, no repair timeline posted.

needs_attention.title: S4 dry texture in candy and slow cook times
needs_attention.summary: Very dry texture detected starting from first line pause at 12:21; pots taking 54 minutes to cook vs 45-minute normal at 12:39.
needs_attention.status: Mary asked if cook time needs adjustment and requested maintenance check at 12:39; no follow-up by window close.

needs_attention.title: Water leaking in IMS area and stagnant water near Trap #70
needs_attention.summary: Ebrima found water leaking in IMS area and stagnant water around pest-control Trap #70 during walkthrough.
needs_attention.status: Reported at 01:59 to facilities and production leads; no response by window close.

needs_attention.title: Condensation from fridge pipe ongoing
needs_attention.summary: Jody reports condensation dripping from pipe going into fridge is an ongoing issue; area dried but keeps returning.
needs_attention.status: Area dried at 02:45, no permanent fix identified.

needs_attention.title: L2 upstairs temperature cold
needs_attention.summary: Thermostat shows 72°F but employees report it is still cold upstairs.
needs_attention.status: William Lopez to check later this afternoon as of 11:21.

needs_attention.title: MF Matrix pouches not sealing
needs_attention.summary: Pouches not sealing at 02:38; maintenance requested to line.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance called at 02:38; no resolution or follow-up posted by window close.

needs_attention.title: Roof leak upstairs dripping near white pipe
needs_attention.summary: Shawn and Angel heard dripping upstairs; found drip coming from where white pipe enters roof.
needs_attention.status: William Lopez to check at L3 later this afternoon as of 11:22.
